# Where each fixture File4Base does not pass yet first fails. See README.md:
# failing earlier or differently fails the test, and so does passing.
#
#   migration@ENGINE ISSUE         the reference file does not migrate on ENGINE,
#                                  for the known cause tracked by ISSUE
#   FIXTURE STEP KIND [ENGINE]     FIXTURE first fails at STEP, with a KIND difference
#
# The /fmi/data skeleton serves sessions, productInfo and databases (P1);
# every other endpoint answers code 3, so its fixtures stop at their first
# step that needs it.
